Results.ReviewText: I've been grilling on Webers since 1985 when I got my first 18" coal bbq.  I had that one (seriously) for more than 30 years, and replaced it with a 22" coal grill with the rotisserie insert.  We moved to Hawaii and I had to get a gas grill for the lanai.  I chose the Spirit II E-310 over a larger unit because it does everything I need it to do and can still be moved easily to make use of our limited space.  I just got a rotisserie attachment, and inaugurated it with a whole chicken that turned out fabulously.  It heats up quickly, cooks everything evenly and well, and cleans up easily.  Couldn't be happier with this gas grill.
Results.Title: Spirit II E-310 is the perfect grill for me

Results.ReviewText: We had a baby Weber that served us well for over a decade, especially for tailgating! But, alas, it died, so we were off to Ace Hardware to replace it. The Spirit ll was the perfect choice. We no longer tailgate, so we didn't need portability. With 3 burners, Spirit ll is a good size for the 2 of us. It allows indirect heating, which is a big plus! What I really like is you can actually control the temperature - something the baby Weber was never good at. The shelf space underneath is handy, as are the side platforms. We've been using it for the last 2 months and have been very pleased with its performance. The friendly Ace Hardware employee delivered and set it up for us, which was much appreciated. Highly recommend this grill - expect it to last for a long time.
Results.Title: 3 Burners are just right for us!

Results.ReviewText:
The packaging in the box was nothing short of an engineering design marvel. Instructions were pretty good and got it together in a little over two hours (spent extra time trying to find the sometimes hidden parts).
Three burners versus the two of my old grill makes a dramatic difference in heat-up time. I've established one benchmark of burner 1 and 2 on set at 6o'clock, 3 off, and that puts it right at 400F.
Steaks and salmon fillets I've transitioned just fine. Beef patties however not so well. This grill has a significant issue with flame ups from grease droppings. I'm not use to dealing with that with my old grill.
Results.Title: Spirit II 3-310 Grill Review - 1mo

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
